facts.fact: leFaso.net reports the Registre Social Unique rollout in Ouahigouya commune, with enumeration from 13 February to 10 March 2025 covering 62,360 households, of which 16,461 poor and vulnerable households (103,312 people) were retained, run by the ST-RSU with WFP support.
